typography.rationale: Sora’s refined geometry and generous letterforms feel premium without drifting into decoration—ideal for an Elegant, high-trust SaaS partner. IBM Plex Sans brings technical precision and excellent numerics for dashboards and proof blocks. The distinct personalities (elegant geometric vs technical humanist) create a sophisticated yet rigorous system suited to decision-makers.

brand_voice.voice_summary: Outreach is measured and bespoke—one insight about their PLG funnel and a clear offer to share a tailored plan. On the site, language is polished and understated, guiding buyers through evidence with confidence. We never sound salesy, never sensationalize, and never drown insights in jargon. Filter: every line should read like a boardroom recommendation.
brand_voice.example_headline: Enterprise-grade pipeline design for sub‑$10M ARR SaaS.

why_these_colors: Deep teal with cool blue secondary cues reads premium and trustworthy while staying firmly in the cold, technical spectrum. The airy highlight and crisp neutrals create a composed canvas for case metrics and board-level visuals. It matches FirstSignal’s methodical, system-building ethos while elevating perceived caliber.
